title: The Hen on the Hat
lines: The hen hops on a tan hat.
The hen did not get up.
Deb got a bit of ham.
The hen hops to the ham.
She hugs the hen. It is a fun pet.

questions.ask: What did the hen sit on?
questions.listenFor: The tan hat. It is in the second line — point at that line rather than saying it.

questions.ask: How did Deb get the hen off the hat?
questions.listenFor: She got a bit of ham, and the hen hopped over to it. Two lines tell it together, so let them read both.

questions.ask: Have you ever got an animal to move without picking it up? How did you do it?
questions.listenFor: Any way — food, a toy, a call. Deb used a bit of ham in line five.
